newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso to trade in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso to trade in narrow range.

text.p: The Philippine peso is expected to trade in a range of 28/28.50 on Wednesday, with the central bank continuing to intervene in the market as banks try to meet commercial demand for dollars, traders said.
"I think the peso will remain pressured. There are lots of bidders but not many sellers," a dealer said.
"Those short on dollars have started to buy following the recent appreciation of the peso. And exporters have started selling their dollars," another said.
The peso closed at 28.15 to dollar on Tuesday from the previous close of 28.
